meta.title: Create Rslib executor for Nx
meta.body_summary: Introduce an Nx plugin for Rslib with build/dev/echo executors, migrate runtime-core to use it, and claim a build time reduction from ~2.6s to ~50ms.

perf_labels.notes: Large-scale plugin addition with migration; merged without formal review, narrative perf claim.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2415 changed lines across 70 files, this is a large-scale build tool plugin addition and migration, consistent with the merged outcome and likely self-merge by a maintainer.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal code review was performed; only a bot comment about missing changeset.
review_details.performance_claim: Build time reduced from ~2.6s to ~50ms by switching from @nx/rollup to the new rslib executor.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cursor successfully created a complex Nx plugin with many generated files and migrated a package to the new build system; merge occurred without formal review, indicating either maintainer trust or lack of peer validation.

detection_detail.code_reading: No evidence of maintainer code review or performance validation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes a narrative build-time reduction claim but no benchmark or reproduction steps for the performance improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions were flagged; merge proceeded without comment.

core_change_summary.description: Introduce a new Nx plugin for Rslib (tools/rslib-plugin) with build, dev, and echo executors, including source and compiled dist files; remove legacy tools/rslib directory; migrate runtime-core from @nx/rollup to the new rslib:build executor with associated tsconfig/config updates.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most changes are boilerplate executor code and configuration; the runtime-core migration accounts for a small portion of the diff.
change_trajectory: Cursor made multiple background composer commits adding the entire rslib-plugin structure and initial migration.
ScriptedAlchemy added commits for TypeScript declaration generation, removing unused scripts, and fixing dual package hazard.
Final fixes to use relative executor paths and pnpm-lock.yaml update.
Merged by ScriptedAlchemy after 20 days with no review.
